meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把仓库里每个 open 的 issue 和 PR 拆成独立后台任务，分类分析，把每条结论都附 commit permalink 证据的报告写到 /tmp/{时间戳}/ 目录。全程只读，不在 GitHub 上评论、合并或关闭。
howto.when: 当你说“triage”、“triage issues”等关键词，或要求对仓库的 issue 与 PR 做只读排查时触发；每个条目各起一个后台任务。

say.text: triage 一下这个仓库的 issue 和 PR
say.note: 每个条目生成一份 /tmp 下的报告
只读分析，不在 GitHub 上做改动
按是否修 bug 分类，逐个出报告

howto.what_en: After install, Claude splits every open issue and PR into its own background task, classifies it, and writes reports to /tmp/{timestamp}/ with each claim backed by a commit permalink. It is read-only: no comments, merges, or closes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "triage", "triage issues", "triage PRs", etc., or ask for a read-only pass over the repo's open issues and PRs. Each item gets one background task.

say_en.text: triage this repo's issues and PRs
triage issues, analyze only, no comments

say_en.note: Each PR classified and reported on
